title: Relationship Manager - GL West
description:
**Location Name:**
Bhucho Mandi - Kanichia Road
  
  
**Job Purpose**
"This position is open with Bajaj finance limited"
  
  
The Branch manager is a managerial responsibility for providing full leadership and direction to the team of employees in growing business and client base of consumer gold loan. The overall objective of this role is to build customer loyalty and recommend the development of business strategies or initiatives and may include the management of activities by external organizations, and the direct management of individuals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Responsible for overall branch operations,performance & profitability of the branch.
* Drive & participate in field-marketing activities of various financial products along with the team to improve brand visibility
* Plan,conduct & monitor the branch & field level marketing activities to ensure health pipeline of leads resulting into business conversion & branch growth
* Focus on customer engagement for new customer acquisitions & retainment of old customers
* Conducting error free valuation & appraisal of gold ornaments being pledged in branch with correct weight & purity assessment as per company policy and auditory compliance
* Joint custodian of the Vault with responsibility of safekeeping of of pledged securities as per company policies
* Responsible for keeping NPAs in control through strong follow-ups from the customers for interest collections
* Good planning abilities are required for smooth functioning of the branch & for developing cohesiveness within the company and co-workers.
* Hiring, coaching, mentoring and training employees and providing them with timely feedback on their performance
* Maintaining quality & performance of the business, preparing various reports of the same and take necessary actions for growth of business in branch
* Increase Gold Loan business, plus various other third-party products i.e., NCD's, Gold Coins sale etc.
* Responsible for keeping NPAs in control through strong follow-ups from the customers for interest collections.
* Responsible for correct valuation & maintenance of 100% process compliance at branch.
* Manage error free valuation & appraisal of gold ornaments being pledged in branch with correct weight & purity assessment as per company policy and auditory compliance.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
Education & Skill Qualifications:
  
  

* 4-7 years of relevant experience required.
* Bachelor’s Degree/Post-graduation Degree preferred.
* Previous experience in gold loan banking, gold loan products, management or client service preferred.
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills.

title: Head, GCFO AI Lead(Singapore, India)
description: Job SummaryThis role could be based in Singapore or India. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based. The GCFO AI lead is accountable for transforming the Finance operating model through process excellence, re-engineering, intelligent automation, and artificial intelligence. The role leads the redesign and optimization of GCFO's end-to-end processes, controls, data, and operating model, embedding simplified, standardized, and scalable ways of working across the function. As the architect of Finance transformation, the role drives continuous improvement, productivity, control effectiveness, and digital innovation, creating a highly efficient, insight-led, and AI-enabled Finance organisation. Beyond GCFO, the role serves as the senior Finance representative across Bank-wide AI and transformation initiatives, ensuring GCFO priorities are reflected in the enterprise AI agenda while accelerating the adoption of responsible AI, automation, and emerging technologies across the function. The role partners with Technology, Data, Operations, Risk, and Business leaders to identify enterprise use cases, influence investment priorities, and scale innovation that delivers measurable business value.Key ResponsibilitiesStrategy Define and own the GCFO Process Excellence and AI Strategy, establishing a clear vision for a future-state Finance platform that is integrated, scalable, resilient, data-driven, and AI-enabled. Shape and deliver the long-term GCFO transformation agenda, translating strategic objectives into a coherent platform roadmap with clear outcomes, milestones, investment priorities, and measurable business value. Serve as the Finance and Treasury champion for enterprise-wide AI transformation, representing GCFO across Bank-wide AI initiatives, influencing cross-functional priorities, and ensuring alignment with the Bank's AI strategy. Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Risk, Technology, Operations, Data, and the Businesses to identify, prioritize, and scale AI opportunities that deliver sustainable productivity, control, and commercial benefits. Architect future-ready operating models that support business growth, enhance organizational agility, and reduce complexity, operational risk, and cost. Champion intelligent automation and digital transformation through the adoption of workflow technologies, RPA, AI/ML, agentic capabilities, and next-generation productivity solutions. Ensure alignment with Group Finance, Risk, Technology, Data, and regulatory strategies while maintaining strong governance, controls, resilience, and audit readiness across both traditional and digital-asset environments. Contribute to the development of the Bank's AI standards, governance frameworks, control environment, and Responsible AI practices, ensuring safe, ethical, and compliant adoption of AI across the enterprise. Monitor emerging AI technologies, regulatory developments, and industry-leading practices, identifying opportunities that advance Finance and Treasury capabilities while strengthening the Bank's competitive advantage.Business Strengthen GCFO’s business partnering model with Finance, Risk, Technology, and the wider business. Ensure GCFO PE and AI materially improves decision-making quality, speed, and insight through predictive, prescriptive, and generative analytics. Support growth, product innovation, and balance-sheet optimisation, including emerging tokenised financial products. Act decisively to address risk and control weaknesses, ensuring issues are remediated and escalated appropriately.Processes Process, Control & Organisation Layer: Establish integrated controllership and operating-model capabilities including iCon, ARIS, Signavio, ProHance, M7, CIMCON, ServiceNow, and WalkMe, embedding control-by-design and auditability. Drive standardisation & harmonisation of processes across regions & business units Drive technology enablement and integration across a complex systems landscape including SAP, non-SAP ERP applications, and emerging AI solutions, ensuring seamless data flow and process automation that reduces manual effort and strengthens controls. Pioneer the adoption of Agent AI and intelligent automation within controllership processes, evaluating use cases, managing implementation, and realizing measurable benefits in efficiency, accuracy, and strategic value delivery. Intelligence Layer: Deliver AI-enabled capabilities including Knowledge Graphs, vector stores, RAG, Digital Twins, LLMs, and Agents to enable advanced analytics and decision support across finance and digital-asset domains. Define defect prevention programs & implement mistake-proofing techniques across critical processesPeople & Talent Build and lead a high-performing GCFO Process excellence organisation spanning platform ownership, product management, data, AI, engineering, and digital-asset expertise. Develop future-ready GCFO talent and act as an evangelist for GCFO digital enablement, and AI adoption.Risk Management Reinforce an exemplary risk and control culture across all GCFO platforms and processes, including those supporting digital assets and tokenised products. Maintain compliance with key regulatory and financial reporting standards. Strengthen the control environment while driving process simplification and efficiency. Embed audit readiness through disciplined governance, documentation, and testing.Governance Establish control and review frameworks for GCFO platforms and processes, ensuring compliance with Group Control Governance and EUC policies. Define and update relevant policies, standards, and guidelines, and ensure platforms are benchmarked against industry best practice.Regulatory & Business Conduct Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct. Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, regulatory compliance, and business conduct across GCFO. Resolve audit and regulatory issues with sustainable, long-term solutions.Key stakeholders Group CFO and GCFO Leadership Team GCFO COO Management Team Group Finance, Risk, Technology, and Data Office Audit, Compliance, and Regulators Regional and Cluster CFOs.Our Ideal Candidate 20+ years of experience with a strong track record of transformation in Finance & Accounting including controllership , FP&A , Regulatory reporting etc Proven experience delivering large-scale finance transformation programmes in an international bank or equivalent regulated institution Strong understanding of Generative AI , LLMs , AI agents , Automation and Analytics Quantifiable benefits through cost reduction, productivity , faster close , better forecasting and controls Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills. Finance AI use cases – Experience applying AI to forecasting, reporting , treasury ,controllership and reconciliations AI Governance – Strong understanding of responsible AI, model risk , controls and regulatory requirements Technology ecosystem – Expert in ERP platforms such as SAP , cloud platforms , GenAI platforms and enterprise AI tools Deep, hands-on expertise in digital assets, process mapping, analysis, and redesign using tools like ARIS, Signavio, or Celonis Strong understanding of accounting, valuation, liquidity, capital, and risk implications of crypto assets, tokenised deposits, stablecoins, CBDCs, and other digital instruments. Experience integrating on-chain and off-chain data and distributed-ledger technologies into enterprise finance and risk platforms. Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt certification preferred Professional certifications (CA, CPA, CFA, CIMA, or equivalent) highly valuedRole Specific Technical Competencies Proven experience in delivering large scale global solution deployments preferably in the financial services environment Finance Domain expertise Process reengineering AI Strategy Roadmap AI Tools and Assets Identification & Management of project Risk/Assumptions/Issues/ Dependencies Advanced Components, e.g. Knowledge Graphs, Agents, LLMs Data and Analytics Change and Adoption Banking and Regulatory knowledgeAbout Standard CharteredWe're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.Together WeDo the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we doNever settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so wellAre better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long termWhat We OfferIn line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkitsA continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.Recruitment AssessmentsSome of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

title: Officer, Specialist, Operations, Trns Svcs-Trade Operations, Corporate Banking, Technology and Operations
description:
**Business Function**
 Group Operations enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble, and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality \& control, technology, people capability and innovation. In Group Operations, we manage the majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels. As an Operations Department, we embrace and reinforce the strong PRIDE! culture that is built up in DBS. This is done through strategic focus on training and improving staff capability, empowerment, productivity, teamwork, innovation \& technology, managing operational risks \& strongly collaborating with our business partners in delivering excellent RED service to our customers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Process and scrutinize Trade transactions as per the applicable FEMA guidelines
* Prepare and submit various MIS reports such as R\-return, CBWTR, EDPMS and IDPMS
* Demonstrate knowledge of processing exports and import transactions
* Assist with other miscellaneous facilities under regulators.

* Knowledge of reporting applicable transactions under various Trade transactions
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work with accuracy
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
